where: Glowmoss Deep (and its B1F), the Spore Grotto, the Sounding Cave and the Grovefall vigil site
mood: The glowing-dark deep forest — a glassy bell melody whose echoes answer across the black, sparse and cathedral-like, with a drained grey shadow in it.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
glassy bell lead with a slow singing melody
faint counter-bell echoing the melody a bar later a fifth higher
breathy sustained pad with cathedral reverb
sparse soft taps and dew-shimmer swells
mysterious glowing dark deep-forest dungeon, quiet wonder with a thread of unease

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet atmospheric entrance: a pad breathes in, dew drips tick, a single glassy bell sounds the first notes of the theme and its echo answers from far away}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the slow bell melody rises through the Lydian raised fourth and hangs there, luminous; the counter-bell echoes each phrase a bar later, like glimmers answering across the dark}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, now with the arpeggios shimmering underneath and the pad swelling, deeper into the wood}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the drained grey ground, the glow gone out; E minor, the arpeggios stop, a low hollow bell line moves slowly over the bass pedal, uneasy and sorrowful, then one bright glint returns}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the glassy bell melody returns with its echoes; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
